entries.reason: iOS 6.1.3 CoreBluetooth exports no such symbol and no kCBAdvDataIsConnectable string, so an application that names the key on 6.1.3 binds to nothing
entries.effect: the constant is the NSString kCBAdvDataIsConnectable, the text the host's CoreBluetooth gives it; an advertisement dictionary of the release carries no such key, so an application reading it there finds nil and the port's Matter stack treats the advertisement as connectable
entries.source: CoreBluetooth.framework/Headers/CBAdvertisementData.h:83 of the iOS 26.2 SDK, CB_EXTERN NSString * const CBAdvertisementDataIsConnectable NS_AVAILABLE(10_9, 7_0); the string read from the host's dyld shared cache (dyld_shared_cache_arm64e.07, macOS 27.0.1, grep -a of kCBAdvDataIsConnectable, NUL-terminated); the 6.1.3 armv7 cache has no such string (tools/image-exports.lua 6.1.3 armv7 CoreBluetooth.framework/CoreBluetooth IsConnectable: 0 of 92 exports)
